name: cniska-task
description: Keeps an agent-task brief from changing under its task while the task runs or is in review: before each Edit, Write or MultiEdit it denies an edit to such a brief, naming stop, the edit and start again; and when a session starts, resumes, clears or compacts in a directory holding one, it puts the running and in-review tasks in the session's context as agent-task list prints them. It needs the agent-task CLI on PATH and does nothing without it.
